side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

manifest.method: Replication of 2b64b269 (Captain Nemo token_delta=2, 6 pairs) with 8 wholly fresh disjoint pairs: 4 removed-from (absent from named surface, other copies unasserted) + 4 erased-from (unrecoverable from every declared copy under recovery model). English = full lossless careful-English gloss with as_of timestamp and declared boundary; ainglish = compact removed-from/erased-from form. tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) per item; per-tokenizer mean; FLOOR = worst (maximum) tokenizer mean. Preserves original estimand/comparator/population.
